description: I'm participating in the Flame in Freefall challenge and looking to build a great team. I have experience coding in Python, Java, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, so I can contribute to both the backend logic and the web interface. To help share the workload and build an impressive project, I'm looking for fellow developers alongside teammates skilled in data analysis, AI/ML, design, or writing and storytelling to help turn our insights into a winning pitch. Reach out if you'd like to collaborate!
